(1) a recurrent neural contextual model can be used to enforce the consistency constraint on segmentation prediction of successive slices in 3D abdominal scans; and (2) Jaccard loss can be used to directly optimize JI, and can be used to replace the traditional Dice loss for deep neural networks.

recurrent neural networks can be very useful in enforcing spatial consistency constraint for segmentation of successive slices in 3D image data, and that Jaccard loss is a good loss function for training segmentation models to optimize JI.
